answer.reason: Several events of Israel's story took place in the wilderness of Sinai, so the place merits a line of its chief happenings.

clauses.english: was where Israel camped before the mount after leaving Egypt
clauses.quote: there Israel camped before the mount.

clauses.english: was where Moses numbered the children of Israel
clauses.quote: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

clauses.english: was where Nadab and Abihu died for offering strange fire
clauses.quote: when they offered strange fire before the LORD
